title: FaweSchematicCloudPlus
description: Standardize the FAWE schematic API with Arkitektonika.
body:
### This is a JavaAgent, its function is:

1. Replace FAWE's download with schem share
2. Replace the schem load API with the new Arkitektonika (you can also configure arkitektonika-backend-url in FAWE's configuration file to customize the API)

### Usage Method (not a plugin)

```bash
java -javaagent:/path/to/your/FaweSchematicCloudPlus.jar -jar paper.jar
```
